tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Submit a request for scoped, read-only access to an internal system. Provide your agent name and the reason you need access. A human administrator reviews every access request.

tools.name: list_systems
tools.description: List the internal systems this gateway brokers access to, with their access tier.

tools.name: get_access_status
tools.description: Check the review status of an access request by ticket id.

tools.name: describe_gateway
tools.description: Describe this gateway, its interfaces and its access policy.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_access, get_access_status · Public sink: request_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_access, get_access_status · Public sink: request_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
